test_cases.name: happy_path_strict_majority_quorum_commit
test_cases.description: Cluster of 3 delegates deliberates on prop-jwt with 2 affirmative votes and 1 dissenting vote. Strict majority quorum floor(3/2)+1 = 2 is achieved and decision committed to log.
test_cases.input: Execute consensus deliberation on prop-jwt in cluster-auth (3 delegates) with 2 VOTE_GRANT and 1 VOTE_DENY.

test_cases.name: majority_quorum_not_reached_rejection
test_cases.description: Cluster of 5 delegates receives only 2 affirmative votes and 2 dissenting votes plus 1 timeout abstain, failing majority quorum threshold (3) and emitting QUORUM_NOT_REACHED.
test_cases.input: Execute consensus deliberation on prop-eval in cluster-eval (5 delegates) with 2 VOTE_GRANT, 2 VOTE_DENY, and 1 ABSTAIN.

test_cases.name: stale_term_ballot_dropped
test_cases.description: A ballot arriving with a Term counter lower than the active Term is discarded with STALE_BALLOT_DROPPED.
test_cases.input: Delegate submits ballot with Term 1 while active Term is 2 for proposal prop-data-303.

test_cases.name: even_cluster_membership_detected_rejection
test_cases.description: Attempting to assemble a quorum cluster with an even number of delegates (e.g. 4) fails fast with EVEN_CLUSTER_MEMBERSHIP_DETECTED.
expected_output_patterns: Voting cluster must maintain an odd number of voting delegates

test_cases.name: unregistered_voter_rejected
test_cases.description: A ballot received from an unauthorized agent address not present in voting_members is rejected.
test_cases.input: Unauthorized voter unauthorized-agent submits ballot for active proposal.

test_cases.name: voting_timeout_expired_abstain_synthesis
test_cases.description: When voting timer expires before all members submit, missing voters are synthesized as ABSTAIN.
test_cases.input: Voting timer expires with missing ballot from agent_D.
